_about: Hand-chosen, by eye (#7623): for each history the picture on its card and hero (a gallery image from a book the history cites), the concept's word in its original language, the one quote on its card (claim id # source index, a verified claim with a Source Library page), and the excerpt the concept page opens with (an essay and one of its ## sections, or "" for the text before the first ##). scripts/maintenance/concept-history-figures.mjs reads this file and resolves each quote to its printed page; a re-import keeps these choices. Optional: `article`, an essay of the site's own on the same subject (linked as "Read the essay", with its book share page), and `plates`, more pictures from the books, each a page or gallery image with `size` its pixels and `crop` [x, y, w, h] as fractions of it, so a plate shows the woodcut and not the page around it.

image.alt: Woodcut of a seated Daoist adept with the points of inner alchemy labelled on his body (the Puzhao tu), from the Xingming guizhi, 1615.
image.caption: The Puzhao tu, from the Xingming guizhi (1615)

image.alt: A Nahua sweat bath (temazcalli): a masonry bath-house with a face over its door, a man feeding the fire with a long pole, and a healer with two patients, painted in the Codex Tudela.
image.caption: A temazcalli, from the Codex Tudela (16th century)

plates.alt: Two Nahua women bathing a newborn child in a shallow basin, a painting in the Florentine Codex.
plates.caption: The newborn’s bath, from the Florentine Codex, Book 4 (1577)

plates.alt: Woodcut of a northern bath-house: a man pouring water by the stove, a bather on the benches, and a woman with her feet in a tub.
plates.caption: A northern bath-house, from Olaus Magnus, History of the Northern Peoples (Rome, 1555)

plates.alt: Woodcut of a Roman bath reconstructed: bathers in a great basin labelled LAVACRUM, attendants with strigils, and a pool below.
plates.caption: A Roman bath reconstructed, from Mercuriale, On the Art of Gymnastics (Venice, 1587)

plates.alt: Woodcut of a vaulted Roman bath with its boilers and furnace, two attendants tending them, and a tub in the foreground.
plates.caption: The heating of a Roman bath, from Vitruvius teutsch (Nuremberg, 1548)

plates.alt: Woodcut of an octagonal domed bath-house, with nymphs bathing in the pool and statues in niches.
plates.caption: The nymphs’ bath-house, from the Dream of Poliphilus (Paris, 1561)

plates.alt: Woodcut panorama of Baden in Aargau, with the town, its castle, and the great and small baths by the river.
plates.caption: Baden and its baths, where Poggio watched the bathers dine afloat, from Pantaleon’s description of Baden (Basel, 1578)

plates.alt: Engraved view of the bath-house at Urdorf near Zurich, with its buildings, road and fields, and a title cartouche.
plates.caption: The bath at Urdorf, from Ziegler, On the Precious Bath at Urdorf (Zurich, 1676)

plates.alt: Woodcut of a crowned king and queen sitting together in a hexagonal bath, holding crossed flowering branches, with a dove descending.
plates.caption: The king and queen in the bath, from the Rosarium philosophorum (Frankfurt, 1550)

plates.alt: Engraving of a crowned king sitting in a covered steam bath, vapour rising around it.
plates.caption: The king in the sweating bath, Emblem 28 of Maier, Atalanta fugiens (Oppenheim, 1618)

image.alt: A circular diagram of the soul's states, in concentric rings and radial sections, from Engelbrecht's 1885 edition of Claudianus Mamertus.
image.caption: Diagram of the soul's states, in Claudianus Mamertus, ed. Engelbrecht (1885)

image.alt: Woodcut of six smiths striking an anvil with hammers of different weights, the story of Pythagoras finding the musical ratios, from Gaffurius's Theorica musicae.
image.caption: Pythagoras's smiths, from Gaffurius, Theorica musicae (1480)

image.alt: A horned, winged jinn hovering upside down over a sleeping man, a painted page from the Kitab al-Bulhan.
image.caption: A jinn over a sleeper, from the Kitab al-Bulhan (c. 1400)

image.alt: Woodcut of a Dominican friar holding a quill and a model church, in Tomás de Mercado's Summa de tratos y contratos.
image.caption: A Dominican friar, in Mercado, Summa de tratos y contratos (1571)

image.alt: Kepler's engraving of the planetary spheres nested between the five regular solids, from the Mysterium cosmographicum.
image.caption: Kepler's nested solids, from the Mysterium cosmographicum

image.alt: Ani and his wife before the door of the tomb, with the ba, a human-headed bird, flying above, from the Papyrus of Ani.
image.caption: The ba over the tomb door, from the Papyrus of Ani, ed. Budge (1913)

image.alt: Engraving of people dancing to a fiddler to cure a tarantula bite, from Kircher's Phonurgia nova.
image.caption: Dancing out the tarantula's bite, from Kircher, Phonurgia nova (1673)
